mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.5% signals a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and a drop in consumer credit (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in housing and consumer spending, which together predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases over 3-year windows, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-crisis recovery phase, a stable or declining inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) relative to the previous year indicates disinflationary pressures that encourage central bank patience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of post-crisis recovery periods despite CPIAUCSL stability, or the Rank IC for the regime-conditional signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an extreme monetary easing policy that typically precedes a rebound in equity markets, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining PAYEMS and rising UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases over 3-year windows, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During an industrial slowdown regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 96.0 indicates reduced manufacturing activity that lowers corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of industrial slowdown periods despite INDPRO below 96.0, or the Rank IC for the regime-conditional signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) relative to the previous quarter signals weak consumer demand that depresses corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 declines, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is negative.
